summary: AIFU Inc., a Nasdaq-listed Cayman holding company with China operations, filed a 6-K disclosing a September 9, 2026 share subscription agreement with Expansion Group Ltd., a BVI entity already holding 13 Class A and 250,000 Class B shares. Expansion will subscribe for 10,000,000 Class B shares at US$0.002 par, or US$20,000 total, for general working capital, closing by end-September 2026. Post-issuance Expansion holds 63.37% of ordinary shares and 99.43% of voting power, a control concentration; watch Nasdaq compliance and minority overhang.
